sheet_log.title: EXTERIOR ELEVATIONS - OPTION 01
sheet_log.scale: 1" = 59'-0" (Overall West Elevation); 1" = 49'-0" (Overall South Elevation); 1" = 29'-0" (Overall East Elevation); 1" = 49'-0" (Overall North Elevation)
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A-201 shows four overall exterior elevations (North, South, East, West) for an industrial warehouse building for Crow Holdings in Bartow County, Georgia. Scales vary by elevation. Door and opening counts cannot be precisely determined from the image resolution - dock door quantities appear numerous (20+ dock doors visible across all elevations combined) but exact counts require higher resolution review. Finish tags 101-103 are color-coded on the elevations (color legend references elevations). Glass schedule shows 3 types (A, B, C) all 1" insulated with Guardian Glass. Keynotes reference details on A-401. Project noted as NOT ISSUED FOR CONSTRUCTION (design review phase). All elevation datum callouts (TI Panel at Entry 44'-2", TI Panel 42'-2", Finish Floor 0'-0", Truck Court -4'-0") are consistent across all four elevations. KD dock equipment (dock levelers) visible at dock bays on West and East elevations.

sheet_log.title: MISC. DETAILS
sheet_log.notes: Sheet A-401 is a miscellaneous details sheet for Crow Holdings Industrial - Cass White Road, Bartow County, Georgia. It contains 13 detail drawings at various scales covering: typical bollard, enlarged ramp plan, ramp with landing section, ramp rail section, stair plan, stair section, stair rail, Z-guard detail, fire riser/electrical panel protection, section at pump/electrical room, plan/side section/section at dock leveler (future). All details are marked NOT ISSUED FOR CONSTRUCTION. Key takeoff items include: 1-1/2" O.D. steel pipe guardrail and handrail runs (quantities to be measured from plan), steel concrete-filled bollards (quantity from plan), open metal grate stair treads (all galvanized), 8" CMU wall at pump room, thickened/tapered concrete slab at dock leveler, dock bumpers, overhead sectional door (see door schedule), concrete retaining wall (see structural), and fire/electrical panel bollard protection. Bollard spacing not to exceed 48" O.C. at electrical panel protection. Dock leveler items noted as FUTURE.
